title: tc-session-state
description:
Where a long LLM session stands: a health pill, tiles for the goal, open loops, pending artifacts and context
pressure, and status chips.

health.description: How the session is going: healthy, drifting, at-risk or stalled; unset hides the pill

healthLabels.description: The health names, merged over the defaults (Healthy, Drifting, At risk, Stalled)

goal.description: The primary goal, for the default tiles

loops.description: The open loops' names, for the default tiles

artifacts.description: The artifacts still to come, for the default tiles

pressure.description: How full the context is, from 0 to 1, for the default tiles; unset leaves the tile out

tiles.description: The page's own tiles, in place of the defaults

chips.description: The status chips under the tiles

warnAt.description: A meter at or above this share turns warning

dangerAt.description: A meter at or above this share turns danger

actionable.description: Makes the tiles buttons that fire tc-action

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

value.description: The big figure: a count, or text such as "68%"

detail.description: One quiet line under the label: the goal, or the loops' names

meter.description: A share from 0 to 1, drawn as a meter; its tone follows `warn-at` and `danger-at` unless `tone` is given

action.description: A button that fires tc-action, e.g. to list the files in context
